answer: An identity locks a 60-credit vault bond and grows a vine of paid endorsements on the public lotus ledger, needing lotus score 100. A client scoring 50 or more adds 40 points, its second endorsement 20, its third 10, halving thereafter. Each job endorses one identity, keyed to payment and output hash. The k-th fake locks a 60-credit vault bond and needs three jobs, more when reused; 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits and need 3,000 jobs. A rented-endorsement ring fails: lotus auditors recompute the vine, spot identical outputs, and burn bonds. An honest agent locks one bond, does three jobs.
